Klasse ControlBuilder<T extends PlotGraph<T>>

java.lang.Object
pr1.a07.plot.ControlBuilder<T>
Typparameter:
T - the concrete subclass of PlotGraph that this builder configures
public class ControlBuilder<T extends PlotGraph<T>> extends Object
A builder class for creating UI control panels for plot graphs. This class provides a fluent API to add interactive controls such as sliders and graph selectors that dynamically update properties of the currently active plot graph instance. Sliders are automatically synchronized with the active graph when the selection changes.

Future enhancements: Additional control types such as choice fields, text fields, checkboxes, and color pickers will be added in upcoming versions to support richer parameter customization.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • ControlBuilder

      public ControlBuilder(PlotControl<T> control, PlotGraphList<T> graphs)
      Constructs a new control builder associated with the given plot control and list of graphs. The first graph in the list is used as the initial active graph.
      Parameter:
      control - the plot control that manages repaint and active graph state
      graphs - the non-empty list of graphs to manage; must not be null
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the graph list is null or empty

  • Methodendetails

    • slider

      public ControlBuilder<T> slider(String label, int min, int max, Function<T,Integer> getter, BiConsumer<T,Integer> setter)
      Adds a labeled slider to the control panel. The slider allows the user to select an integer value within a specified range. When the slider value changes, the provided setter is invoked on the currently active graph, and the application view is repainted.

      When the active graph is changed (e.g., via a selector), the slider value is automatically updated to reflect the new graph's current property value.

      Parameter:
      label - the label displayed on the slider border
      min - the minimum value of the slider
      max - the maximum value of the slider
      getter - a function that retrieves the current integer value from a graph
      setter - a bi-consumer that accepts a graph and an integer value to update it
      Gibt zurück:
      this builder instance for method chaining

    • selector

      public ControlBuilder<T> selector(String title, String label)
      Adds a drop-down selector that allows the user to choose which graph in the list should be actively controlled. When a new graph is selected, all associated sliders are updated to reflect that graph's current parameter values.
      Parameter:
      label - the base label used to generate item names (e.g., "Plot" -> "Plot 1", "Plot 2")
      Gibt zurück:
      this builder instance for method chaining

    • getPanel

      public JPanel getPanel()
      Returns the constructed JPanel containing all added controls.
      Gibt zurück:
      the control panel ready to be added to a container
